Application Data.NAME: HomeTech Solutions LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: HomeTech Solutions LLC specializes in the sale and repair of home appliances, including refrigerators, washing machines, dryers, and kitchen appliances. Our operations include direct retail sales, in-home consultations for appliance selection, and providing repair services both on-site and in-house. We focus on delivering high-quality customer service and ensuring customer satisfaction through reliable appliance solutions and expert repairs.
